offering_description.value: Sells property and casualty insurance in the US to individuals and businesses, covering homes, vehicles, and commercial and specialty risks. Policies are written mainly through independent agents and brokers, and the company handles claims and underwriting.

primary_products.value: homeowners insurance; automobile insurance; commercial multiple peril insurance; workers' compensation insurance; specialty commercial insurance

primary_services.value: claims handling; risk management and loss control

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, commercial insurance buyers; B2C: individual homeowners and vehicle owners

end_markets.value: small business; middle market commercial; personal property and auto

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums paid by policyholders, plus investment income on reserves

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums and underwrites risk, paying claims to policyholders

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across the United States through licensed state insurance entities

specialization.value: related lines: personal lines and commercial lines, sharing agents, underwriting and claims systems

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and brokers; online: online and digital policy purchase and service for personal lines

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensed and rate-regulated by state insurance departments in each state where it writes policies
